ov: بوغونيا (الإنجليزية: Bugonia) هو فلم خيال علمي كوميدي من إخراج يورغوس لانثيموس وسيناريو ويل تريسي. وهو إعادة إنتاج باللغة الإنكليزية للفلم الكوري الجنوبي «أنقذوا الكوكب الأخضر!» (2003) للمخرج جانغ جون هوان. الفلم من بطولة إيما ستون وجيسي بليمونز. عُرض الفلم أول مرة في الولايات المتحدة وكندا في 24 أكتوبر 2025.
plotEn:
Conspiracy theorist Teddy Gatz and his cousin Don abduct Michelle Fuller, the CEO of pharmaceutical conglomerate Auxolith. Teddy's mother, Sandy, previously participated in a clinical trial for an Auxolith drug that rendered her comatose. Teddy believes Michelle is a member of a malignant alien species, the Andromedans, who are killing Earth's honeybees and forcing humans into subservience.
Teddy and a reluctant Don imprison Michelle in their basement, shave her head, and cover her body in antihistamine cream to prevent her from sending a distress signal to other Andromedans. Teddy explains that she has four days to negotiate a meeting with the Andromedan emperor before an upcoming lunar eclipse, which will allow the Andromedan mothership to enter Earth's atmosphere undetected.
After torturing Michelle with electricity, Teddy concludes from her high pain tolerance that she is a high-ranking member of the Andromedan royal family. With sudden new respect, Teddy apologizes to Michelle, releases her from the basement and invites her upstairs for dinner. The tense meal culminates in a physical fight between Teddy and Michelle. They are interrupted by the arrival of Casey, a local deputy sheriff and Teddy's childhood babysitter, who is searching for Michelle. Don knocks Michelle unconscious and chains her to the floor of the basement. Teddy distracts Casey by showing him the apiary in the backyard.
